concepts.name: Acorn Squash
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4750 starts the squash zone. Spaghetti squash=4776.

concepts.name: Anaheim Pepper
concepts.card_note: 4677. Long, mild green chile. New Mexico chile=4700. Common in Southwestern cooking.

concepts.name: Anjou Pears
concepts.card_note: Small (4025) is in the fruit row. Large (4416) is in the pear zone. Red D'Anjou=4417.

most_common.reason: Large D'Anjou is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Apricots
concepts.card_note: 4218=small/standard apricot; 3302=large. Red apricot is 3614.

concepts.name: Asparagus Green
concepts.card_note: Standard (4080) is the common one — right at the edge of the veggie block after cauliflower (4079). Jumbo (4521) is less common. White asparagus=4522, Purple=3079.

most_common.reason: Standard green asparagus is the everyday item; jumbo is specialty

concepts.name: Avocado Green
concepts.card_note: Two standards: 4221/4771/4223 = East North America. 4222/4224 = international, rarely correct in US stores. Check yours.

concepts.name: Avocado Hass
concepts.card_note: Three sizes! 4046 is the most common (small/med). Don't learn just one — all three show up at retail. Green-skin varieties have different codes entirely (4222, 4771).

most_common.reason: Small/medium Hass is the highest volume avocado SKU in the US

concepts.name: Bananas
concepts.card_note: 4011 is the common banana code; 4186 is small. Do not assume every banana uses 4011.

concepts.name: Bartlett Pears
concepts.card_note: Small (4024) is in the fruit row near grapes. Large (4409) is in the pear zone (4409-4423). Red Bartlett=4410.

most_common.reason: Large Bartlett is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Basil
concepts.card_note: 4885. Opal basil=4886, Sweet basil=4887. Herbs are clustered 4885-4908: Basil(4885), Chives(4888), Cilantro(4889), Dill(4891), Mint(4896), Parsley curly(4899), Parsley Italian(4901), Rosemary(4903), Thyme(4907).

concepts.name: Beets Bunch
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4539. Golden beets=4540. In the 45xx root vegetable zone.

concepts.name: Bosc Pears
concepts.card_note: Bosc is the most complex pear — 4 codes split by size AND region, similar to navel orange. 4026 (West) is in the fruit row. 4411-4413 are in the pear zone.

most_common.reason: Large West Bosc is most common — majority of US pears come from WA/OR

concepts.name: Braeburn Apples
concepts.card_note: Small=4101, Large=4103. In the 41xx apple zone. Two apart like Fuji and Gala.

most_common.reason: Large Braeburn is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Broccoli
concepts.card_note: Crowns (3082) are most common at retail. Bunch (4060) is in the veggie block. Florettes (4548) for pre-cut. Don't confuse with cauliflower florettes (4566).

most_common.reason: Crowns outsell whole bunch broccoli at most retailers

concepts.name: Butternut Squash
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4759 is in the squash zone (4750-4770). Acorn=4750, Spaghetti=4776.

concepts.name: Cantaloupe
concepts.card_note: Two sizes. 4050 (large) is more common. Don't confuse 4032 with cantaloupe — that's seedless watermelon!

most_common.reason: Large cantaloupe is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Carrots Loose
concepts.card_note: No size split. Bunch carrots = 4094, Baby = 4560, Sticks = 4563. Loose (4562) is the most common bulk code.

concepts.name: Cauliflower
concepts.card_note: 4079 is the small/standard cauliflower code; 4572 is large. Florettes=4566; Green=4567; Purple=4568.

most_common.reason: Small/standard whole head is the most common; florettes growing in popularity

concepts.name: Celery
concepts.card_note: 4070 (small) is the common one — nice round number in the veggie block. Large (4583) is in the 45xx zone. Hearts=4575, Sticks=4576.

most_common.reason: Small bunch (4070) is what most stores stock as their standard celery

concepts.name: Cherry Tomatoes
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4796. Yellow cherry=4797. Most cherry/grape tomatoes are sold in clamshells with UPCs, but loose ones need the PLU.

concepts.name: Cilantro
concepts.card_note: No size split. Cilantro=4889, Dill=4891, Mint=4896. Italian parsley=4901 and curly parsley=4899.

concepts.name: Coconut In Husk
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4260. Young/green coconut and coconut water are usually sold with UPCs.

concepts.name: Corn Yellow Trimmed
concepts.card_note: No size split. White corn=4077. Yellow (4078) is far more common.

concepts.name: Cremini Mushrooms
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4648 is in mushroom row (4645-4652). Cremini are actually baby portabellas — same species (Agaricus bisporus) as white button and portabella, just different growth stages.

concepts.name: Cucumber
concepts.card_note: No size split. English/Long Seedless=4593. Hot House=4593.

concepts.name: Dill
concepts.card_note: 4891. Pickling dill=4893 (different code). Regular dill is used fresh; pickling dill includes the flower head.

concepts.name: Eggplant
concepts.card_note: 4081 is regular purple eggplant. Chinese=3089, Thai=3090, Japanese=4601.

concepts.name: Enjoya Stripy Bell Peppers All Sizes
Fuji Apples
concepts.card_note: Small=4129, Large=4131. Compare to Gala (4133/4135) — Fuji codes are 4 less than Gala for each size.

most_common.reason: Large Fuji is the most stocked size

concepts.name: Gala Apples
concepts.card_note: West uses odd codes: 4133 small, 4135 large. East/Central uses even codes: 4132 small, 4134 large.

most_common.reason: Large Gala is the most stocked size

concepts.name: Garlic
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4608 is in the 46xx zone with mushrooms and shallots (4662).

concepts.name: Ginger Root
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4612. Often sold by weight. In the 46xx zone near garlic (4608) and collard greens (4614).

concepts.name: Golden Delicious Apples
concepts.card_note: The reversal is West-only: 4020 large, 4021 small. East/Central is normal: 4136 small, 4137 large. Extra large=3285.

most_common.reason: Large Golden Delicious is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Granny Smith Apples
concepts.card_note: ⚠️ Unlike Gala/Fuji where small and large are 2 apart, Granny Smith codes are wildly separated: 4139 vs 4017. Large (4017) is near banana (4011) and orange (4012)!

most_common.reason: Large Granny Smith is the most stocked size

concepts.name: Grapefruit Ruby Red
concepts.card_note: 4027 is the common small Ruby Red grapefruit code; 4047 is the small alternate. Large=4281.

most_common.reason: Small/standard grapefruit is more common than jumbo

concepts.name: Grapes Red Seedless
concepts.card_note: No size split. Green seedless=4022, Black seedless=4056. Red Globe (seeded)=4636.

concepts.name: Green Beans
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4066 is in the veggie block between green bell pepper (4065) and zucchini (4067).

concepts.name: Green Bell Pepper
concepts.card_note: 4065 is the everyday field-grown large green pepper; 4681 is field-grown small. Greenhouse small/large=3119/3120.

most_common.reason: Field grown large green pepper is the standard grocery item

concepts.name: Green Cabbage
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4069 is in the veggie block between green onion (4068) and celery (4070). Red cabbage=4554, Napa=4552.

concepts.name: Green Grapes Seedless
concepts.card_note: No size split. Red seedless (4023) minus 1 = green seedless (4022).

concepts.name: Green Leaf Lettuce
concepts.card_note: 4076 sits between red leaf lettuce 4075 and white corn 4077. Sweet potato is 4074.

concepts.name: Green Onions Scallions
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4068 is in the veggie block between zucchini (4067) and green cabbage (4069). Different from shallots (4662) and leeks (4629).

concepts.name: Habanero Pepper
concepts.card_note: 3125 — the only common hot pepper in the 3xxx range. Very hot. Don't confuse with scotch bonnet (similar look, different code).

concepts.name: Honeycrisp Apples
concepts.card_note: Honeycrisp has a size split: 3283 large, 3468 small. Both live in the 3xxx range.

concepts.name: Honeydew Melon
concepts.card_note: Small (4329) and Large (4034). Gold honeydew=3100. Large honeydew (4034) is in the fruit row near lemons and kiwi.

most_common.reason: Large honeydew is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Iceberg Lettuce
concepts.card_note: No size split. Romaine=4640, Green Leaf=4076, Boston/Butter=4632.

concepts.name: Ifg Novelty Green Seedless Cotton Candy Grapes
Jalapeno Pepper
concepts.card_note: Green (4693) is far more common. Red (4694) is just a ripe green jalapeño. Both in the hot pepper zone (4690s).

most_common.reason: Green jalapeño is 90%+ of jalapeño sales

concepts.name: Kiwifruit
concepts.card_note: Regular=4030. Jumbo/XL=3280. Gold kiwi=4301.

concepts.name: Leeks
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4629. Baby leek=4630. Not the same as green onion (4068) — leeks are much larger.

concepts.name: Lemons
concepts.card_note: Three sizes. 4053 (large) is the most commonly seen. No regional split like oranges.

most_common.reason: Large lemons are the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Limes
concepts.card_note: Two varieties. Regular (4048) is the common grocery lime. Key Lime (4305) is smaller, rounder, more aromatic — used in Key Lime pie. Neither has a size split.

most_common.reason: Regular Persian lime is 95%+ of lime sales

concepts.name: Mango Yellow
concepts.card_note: Mangos are coded by SKIN COLOR: Red=4051/4959 (wave 14), Yellow/Ataulfo=4312/4961, Green/Keitt=4311. Ataulfo is flatter, creamier, and less fibrous than red varieties.

most_common.reason: Small Ataulfo is the standard size — they're naturally smaller than red mangos

concepts.name: Mangoes Red
concepts.card_note: Mango PLUs are organized by SKIN COLOR, not variety. Red covers Tommy Atkins, Kent, Haden, etc. Yellow/Ataulfo mango is a separate code: 4312 (small), 4961 (large). Green/Keitt=4311.

most_common.reason: Small red mango (Tommy Atkins etc.) is the most common size at retail

concepts.name: Mint
concepts.card_note: 4896. In the herb cluster between lemon grass (4894) and oregano (4897).

concepts.name: Mushrooms Horn Of Plenty Black Trumpet
Navel Oranges
concepts.card_note: ⚠️ FIVE codes! Split by region AND size. Higher case count = smaller fruit. East/Central 'Large' (100ct) is actually SMALLER than West 'Medium' (88ct). West codes are most common since CA produces most US navels.

most_common.reason: Large West navel (56ct) is the most common; CA produces most US navels

concepts.name: Nectarines Yellow
concepts.card_note: 4035 (small) and 4036 (large) — consecutive numbers in the fruit row. White nectarine (tree-ripened)=3035.

most_common.reason: Large yellow nectarine is the standard retail size

concepts.name: Orange Bell Pepper
concepts.card_note: Field (4682) vs Greenhouse (3121). Orange greenhouse is in the 3xxx range — the only common greenhouse pepper there. Compare: Red greenhouse=4688, Yellow greenhouse=4689.

most_common.reason: Most orange bells at retail are greenhouse grown

concepts.name: Papaya Regular
concepts.card_note: 4394 is regular large papaya. 4052 is the standard small Solo/Hawaiian papaya code. Cooking/Mexican papaya=4395.

concepts.name: Parsley Curly
concepts.card_note: 4899. Two apart from Italian (4901). Curly is more commonly used as garnish.

concepts.name: Parsley Italian Flat Leaf
concepts.card_note: 4901. Looks very similar to cilantro (4889) — one of the most common produce mix-ups. Curly parsley=4899.

concepts.name: Peaches Yellow Flesh
concepts.card_note: 4037 is small yellow peach; 4038 is large. 4044 is tree-ripened/ready-to-eat, not the regular large code.

most_common.reason: Large/ready-to-eat yellow peach is the standard retail size

concepts.name: Pickling Cucumbers
concepts.card_note: 4596 is pickling cucumber/Kirby: short, firm, and crisp, suited for pickling.

concepts.name: Pineapple
concepts.card_note: Small (4029) is in the fruit row. Large (4430) is in the 44xx zone. Most stores carry large — 4430 is the more common code.

most_common.reason: Large pineapple is what most stores carry

concepts.name: Pink Lady Apples
concepts.card_note: Small=4128, Large=4130. Right before Fuji (4129/4131) in Apple Alley. Pink Lady is a trademarked name for Cripps Pink variety.

most_common.reason: Large Pink Lady is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Plantains
concepts.card_note: 4235. Looks like a large banana but must be cooked. NOT banana (4011). Common in Latin, Caribbean, and African cooking.

concepts.name: Plums Black
concepts.card_note: Black (4040) and Red (4042) — both in the fruit row. Pluots/Plumcots have their own codes (3278, etc.).

most_common.reason: Black plum is more widely stocked than red plum

concepts.name: Poblano Pepper
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4705. The dried version is called Ancho. Mild heat, large size — often stuffed.

concepts.name: Portabella Mushrooms
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4650. Same species as cremini (4648) and button (4645/4085) — just fully mature.

concepts.name: Radishes Red Bunch
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4089 is in the veggie block right after red bell pepper field (4088). Daikon radish=4598.

concepts.name: Red Bell Pepper
concepts.card_note: Field grown (4088) is in the veggie block right after Roma tomato (4087). Greenhouse (4688) is in the 46xx zone. Your store may use one or the other — check what's stocked.

most_common.reason: Varies by store — field grown (4088) is traditional, greenhouse (4688) growing. Check your store's source.

concepts.name: Red Black Cherries
concepts.card_note: 4045 is the common all-sizes red/black cherry code. Size-specific codes also exist: 3357 small, 3358 large.

concepts.name: Red Delicious Apples
concepts.card_note: 5 codes! Regional + size split like navel orange. West codes (4015/4016) are in the fruit row near Granny Smith large (4017). East codes (4167/4168) are in the apple zone.

most_common.reason: Large West Red Delicious is the standard grocery size

concepts.name: Red Onion
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4082 is in the veggie block. Unlike yellow onion which has small (4665) and large (4093), red onion is one code for all sizes.

concepts.name: Red Potatoes
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4073 is right next to russet (4072) in the veggie block. White=4083, Yellow/Yukon=4727.

concepts.name: Roma Tomatoes
concepts.card_note: No size split. Official name is Plum/Italian/Saladette/Roma. NOT 3151 (that's Vine Ripe Large).

concepts.name: Romaine Lettuce
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4640 is in the 46xx zone, NOT in the veggie block with iceberg (4061). Romaine hearts are often sold bagged with a UPC, not a PLU.

concepts.name: Russet Potatoes
concepts.card_note: No size split. Other potato types: Red=4073, White=4083, Yellow=4727.

concepts.name: Serrano Pepper
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4709 is in the 47xx hot pepper zone. Smaller and hotter than jalapeño.

concepts.name: Shallots
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4662 is in the 46xx onion zone near white onion (4663) and vine tomato (4664).

concepts.name: Spaghetti Squash
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4776 is in the squash zone (4750-4789). Popular low-carb pasta substitute.

concepts.name: Spinach Bunch
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4090 is in the veggie block near onion (4093).

concepts.name: Squash Acorn Swan White Table Queen
Sunny Gold Yellow Mini Seedless Watermelon
Sweet Potatoes Yam
concepts.card_note: Complex family. The orange-fleshed sweet potato most people buy is 4074 (small) or 4817 (large). Golden (4816) and White (4091) are different varieties. 4091 is in the veggie block; 4074 is too.

most_common.reason: Small orange-fleshed sweet potato is the most common grocery sweet potato

concepts.name: Tangerines
concepts.card_note: 4055 covers loose tangerines/mandarins. Cuties, Halos, etc. in bags have UPCs, but loose ones at the bin need this PLU. Right after raspberries (4054) in the fruit row.

concepts.name: Tomatillos
concepts.card_note: 4801. Looks like a small green tomato in a papery husk. Essential for salsa verde. NOT a green tomato.

concepts.name: Tomatoes Greenhouse
concepts.card_note: 4799 is actually the greenhouse/hydroponic regular tomato (large). True grape tomatoes are often sold under retailer-assigned codes or UPC clamshells. Check your store's system.

concepts.name: Tomatoes On The Vine
concepts.card_note: This is tomatoes sold still attached to the vine/truss. Different from Vine RIPE (3151/4805) which is about ripening method. 4664 is near yellow onion small (4665).

concepts.name: Vine Ripe Tomatoes
concepts.card_note: Vine Ripe has a size split! 3151 is the large — this is NOT Roma (Roma=4087). On-the-vine/truss tomato (picked still on vine) = 4664, which is a different thing.

most_common.reason: Large vine ripe is the standard tomato size

concepts.name: Watermelon Red
concepts.card_note: Seeded=4031, Seedless=4032. Seedless is far more common today. Mini seedless=3421. Yellow seeded=4340, yellow seedless=4341.

most_common.reason: Seedless has almost entirely replaced seeded watermelon at retail

concepts.name: White Button Mushrooms
concepts.card_note: Small (4645) is in the 46xx mushroom zone. Large (4085) is in the veggie block! Cremini/Brown=4648, Portabella=4650. These are technically the same species at different growth stages.

most_common.reason: Large button mushrooms (8oz/16oz packs) are the standard retail size

concepts.name: White Onion
concepts.card_note: White onion=4663. Compare yellow large=4093, yellow small=4665, and red=4082.

concepts.name: Yellow Bell Pepper
concepts.card_note: Field (4680) vs Greenhouse (4689). Compare: Green field=4065, Red field=4088, Yellow field=4680. No clean pattern between colors!

most_common.reason: Most yellow bells at grocery are greenhouse grown (4689), but check your store

concepts.name: Yellow Onion
concepts.card_note: Two sizes! Large (4093) is in the veggie block. Small (4665) is way up in the 46xx range near mushrooms.

most_common.reason: Large yellow onions outsell small at most stores

concepts.name: Yellow Squash Crookneck
concepts.card_note: No size split. 4784. The common 'yellow squash' at grocery. Straightneck yellow=4782. Different from yellow zucchini (4086).

concepts.name: Yellow Squash Straightneck
concepts.card_note: 4782. Some stores use this interchangeably with crookneck (4784) — the shape of the neck is the difference.

concepts.name: Zucchini
concepts.card_note: No size split. Yellow zucchini/gold bar=4086. Regular zucchini (4067) is in the veggie block between green pepper (4065) and green onion (4068).
